scope: Screened every noninitial displayed flag. Candidates are off-bar flags on the last chord of a bar followed by a ii or iiø, a V or tritone substitute, and a tonic. The ii–V must begin on the next bar and remain inside the incoming region. The tonic may land at its end and serve as a pivot at the next flag. The strict analog adds a change of bass alone, no named join at the displayed flag, and no direct ii, V, or I function for that pre-bar chord.

openingException.title: Whisper Not
openingException.rationale: The previous projection displayed F minor from beat 0. The printed opening Cm7 and Cm7/Bb establish a local C-minor setting, normalized to B♭ minor in the reader. The revised display uses that opening setting and starts F minor at measure 2 with the first iiø.
